method: Expected labels are committed before evaluation. Actual PNG originals contain the fixture merchant/date/amount. Receipt merchant metadata is entered, not OCR. Ingestion has no receipt MCC. The second phase uses per-original native matching consent and real private charge questions; where tip-tolerant matching is ambiguous, the employee confirms the single exact-total charge through the existing attachment door. The actual linked card MCC fills only still-empty suggestion fields. No label is supplied to the application.
denominators: Full repeat counts every repeat charge and original, including archived-account and unknown-label abstentions as nonmatches. Eligible repeat separately counts repeat records with an active expected category. Overall category/class/project count all non-null business labels, with missing suggestions counted as nonmatches. The 24 final category abstentions are 12 unknown-merchant and 12 retired-account records.
limitations: Statement files are not a live issuer feed.
Receipt merchant metadata is entered by the employee; CAPTURE-003 reading remains unavailable.
Unlinked receipt ingestion alone does not meet the full repeat-category bar.
